entries.title: A batch whose merge Bitbucket keeps showing as running no longer waits in silence
entries.body: When Bitbucket takes a batch's merge and keeps showing it as running, Settings → Projects now shows the batch waiting for its merge, with its pull request and Try again, and the Activity feed says so once. Nothing is sent again on its own. If the pull request on Bitbucket shows no merge running, Try again sends a new merge that also carries the changes you approved meanwhile.

picture.alt: Settings → Projects for a Bitbucket project: under Where changes go, a batch waiting for its merge, with Open #1 and Try again.
